overview: ShopCatalog is an Amazon-style e-commerce platform with full order management and tracking. Customers can view their orders, track status with a visual timeline, manage cancellations and returns. Admins can manage all orders, update statuses in bulk, and customers receive in-app notifications on status changes.
features: Order list with color-coded status badges and filter tabs (All, Active, Completed, Cancelled)
Visual Amazon-style order status timeline: Placed → Confirmed → Packed → Shipped → Out for Delivery → Delivered
Order detail page with items, delivery address, payment info, and estimated delivery date
Cancel Order button for Placed/Confirmed orders; Return/Replace for Delivered orders within 7 days
Admin order management with search, per-row status update, and bulk status update
In-app notifications when order status changes
Full Amazon-style UI with orange (#FF9900) accent and clean layout
